topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: The day is as gray as my thoughts when my neighbor stops by, her eyes hopeful, almost shimmering with anticipation. She asks, with a smile so bright it seems borrowed from a sunnier day, if she might use a portion of my yard for a garden. The space, she assures me, will remain tidy, a shared beauty that might bloom between us. I find myself nodding, the words of agreement slipping out almost despite myself. I can see, in her excitement, the seeds of something vibrant and alive, a stark contrast to the quiet solitude that has settled here. I tell myself this is a good thing, a step towards a different kind of life. Yet, as she leaves, the weight of the empty yard presses down on me, a reminder of what isn’t there.
